caption:
are the dots on my nose blackheads?

Usually not. The small, flat, grey dots spread evenly across the nose are most often sebaceous filaments: a normal structure inside your pores.

Blackheads tend to be darker, slightly raised, and fewer.

Pull a filament out and it comes back. A 1976 study found the pore refilled within about 30 days.

General education only.
